meaning: Observe actual generated Rule producers consumed by generated Policies, comparing ordered nested calls, exact normalized arguments, Boolean results and selected target identifiers against an independent checked-source interpreter.
scope: Private TypeScript Rule-to-Policy interoperability family under the complete cross-generator boundary denominator. Preserve all other runtime edges as uncovered. No public pass, source capsule entry, output-format change or target execution.
binding: Require the exact definition and registered graph, reconciled plan and cross-generator inventory with matching graph/source/plan identities. Derive Policy wrapper/provider and Rule paths and callable names from qualified source identity and pinned configuration roles; derive every transitive Rule dependency from source expressions. Compare complete native imports and owned module hashes with the selected boundary, including wrapper-to-provider wiring.
oracle: Add a trace-only Policy evaluation API to the existing independent Rule interpreter. Preserve its existing evaluation APIs. Record each actual source Rule call on entry with parent call index and named normalized arguments, then its Boolean result. Preserve Policy first-true order, nested Rule short-circuiting, repeated calls, exact UInt64 and structural value semantics. Do not derive expected results from generated descriptors, native code or observer output.
cases: Reuse the source-derived structural fact recipes and hostile input families. Compare valid calls and selected targets, and require malformed Policy inputs to fail without Rule calls, getters or input mutation. Preserve constant/unreachable cases as not_evaluable when finite cases lack distinct targets or leave a selected Rule unvisited. Finite coverage is not proof that unvisited branches are unreachable. Bound the whole family at 4096 cases, 65536 traced calls and 8 MiB serialized controls; never return a passing prefix on exhaustion.
native_observer: Compile exact generated source to a private CommonJS test tree. In a fresh permission-restricted Node child, wrap only the selected generated Rule exports, retaining and calling the original functions. Wrappers observe input and Boolean result; original Policy and Rule bodies remain the subject of execution. Reuse the existing structural recipe observer for input/getter/mutation checks. No expected outcomes, traces or source-oracle callback enter the child payload. This instrumented test lane is not a new product compilation default or proof of uninstrumented behavior.
observations: Match the full ordered selector/case/outcome/call/parent/argument/result/getter/mutation structure against registered expected controls. Missing, duplicate, extra, reordered or foreign observations reject; caller clones do not revive registered controls. Bind returned finite evidence to source inventory, selected native modules and complete case-family identity. No result here establishes on-disk source, emitted artifact or tool currentness through the public executor.
verification: source trace agrees with unchanged Policy reference outcome
actual native Rule-to-Policy and nested Rule calls in two module roots
first-true and repeated-call order, argument renaming and exact UInt64
structural record projection, collection conversion and invalid inputs
native-compiling wrong arguments, wrong predicate, wrong call count and wrong ordering reject
missing, duplicate, reordered, extra and foreign observations reject
uncovered runtime edges and incomplete finite witness families remain explicit
remaining: Integrate independent native surface auditing, source/emitted/tool custody and final currentness into a private executor before public verification; add other producer-consumer families and preserve full R08-R18 scope.
effects: Only local candidate construction and task-owned test fixtures. No production provider, Policy target, endpoint, compensation, installation, publication, admission or release is executed or authorized.
caller_edge_coverage: Every provider-to-Rule and Rule-to-Rule edge in the source-derived protocol must have a finite call witness identified by its exact importer and callee. Derive parent-specific edge visit counts from the independent source trace and match the original native call trace in full. A callee reached through another parent never covers an unvisited edge; retain the entire family as not_evaluable. Keep wrapper/provider forwarding distinct from Rule-call edges: forwarding is bound by source/native surface and root behavior checks, not fabricated Rule invocations.
